free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence converges on further investigation due to multiple concerning factors. The PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone, combined with a rising PSA velocity of 1.2 ng/mL/yr and a high csPCa probability of 0.75, strongly supports sampling. The PSA has risen from 6.3 ng/mL to 7.8 ng/mL, and the PSA density of 0.165 ng/mL/mL is elevated, which together mandate a biopsy.
